title: Pod Security Standards: privileged containers
applicable_condition: A supported Linux Deployment fails the privileged-container check.
guidance: Baseline policy disallows privileged containers. Leave privileged unset or set it to false.
limitation: Host or device access needs human review before changing this setting.

title: Pod Security Standards: privilege escalation
applicable_condition: The selected check reports privilege escalation is not disabled.
guidance: For Linux workloads, Restricted policy requires allowPrivilegeEscalation: false on containers.
limitation: Application behavior under this restriction is not tested by retrieval.

title: Pod Security Standards: non-root execution
applicable_condition: The selected check reports missing or incompatible non-root settings.
guidance: Restricted policy requires runAsNonRoot: true at pod or container level and prohibits an explicit runAsUser of zero.
limitation: Checkov may accept a positive runAsUser alone; that does not establish full Restricted-policy compliance.

title: Pod Security Standards: Linux capabilities
applicable_condition: A selected capability-dropping check fails on the application container.
guidance: Restricted Linux policy requires dropping ALL capabilities; only NET_BIND_SERVICE may be added back.
limitation: The selected dropping checks do not independently establish that added capabilities satisfy the entire policy.

title: Pod Security Standards: seccomp profiles
applicable_condition: The selected seccomp policy reports a failed check.
guidance: Restricted Linux policy permits RuntimeDefault or Localhost seccomp profiles, configured at pod level or for every container.
limitation: CKV_K8S_31 in the pinned Checkov release prefers RuntimeDefault; a Localhost profile can meet the documented standard yet fail that check.

title: Security context: pod and container settings
applicable_condition: Pod and container user settings need review together.
guidance: Container security settings override corresponding pod settings for that container. Review both locations when choosing a non-root user.
limitation: A successful static check does not prove that the image or mounted files work with the chosen user.

title: Security context: add or drop capabilities
applicable_condition: The application container needs a capabilities review.
guidance: Use the container securityContext.capabilities fields to add or drop individual Linux privileges. Capability names in manifests omit the CAP_ prefix.
limitation: Determine application requirements before removing permissions; retrieval does not test them.

title: Service accounts: opt out of credential automounting
applicable_condition: The selected token-mounting check fails; confirm whether the application needs API credentials.
guidance: Set automountServiceAccountToken: false in the pod specification to opt out of automatic API credential mounting. The pod setting takes precedence over the ServiceAccount setting.
limitation: Disabling automount can affect applications using those credentials. An omitted field alone cannot reveal the referenced ServiceAccount configuration.

title: OWASP: assess container privileges
applicable_condition: Reviewing a selected container privilege finding.
guidance: Grant containers only the privileges and capabilities required for their intended function. Reassess those privileges as the application changes.
limitation: General least-privilege guidance is not evidence that a particular configuration change preserves application behavior.

title: OWASP: limit automatic API credentials
applicable_condition: Reviewing whether a pod requires automatically mounted Kubernetes API credentials.
guidance: Disable automatic service-account token mounting when the pod does not need Kubernetes API credentials.
limitation: The application owner must confirm credential requirements before accepting a change.
